products.name: IFB 7.5 kg top-load washing machine with Ai, Power Steam and Eco Inverter Motor
products.summary: Lift the tinted glass lid, pull out the ActivMix tray and look into the drum with its triadic pulsator, then place it in your home at its real size.
products.arTip: Tap the lid to open it
products.sizeNote: 94.6 cm tall with the lid shut; IFB gives no height with the lid open
specs: Eco Inverter Motor, 10 years motor warranty
5 star (BEE), 0.0065 kWh/kg/cycle on its energy label
9: Mix/Daily, Cotton, Express 30', Delicates, Baby Wear, StainFighter, Bulky, Anti-Allergen and Tub Clean
Ai, Power Steam with in-built heater, Aqua Energie, ActivMix, Pre Clean, Shower Rinse, Air Dry, Delay Start, Auto Tub Clean
Triadic pulsator, lint tower filter; hot wash at 40 and 60 °C and Steam; 10 water levels
Membrane keys with tactile switches, amber LED display, panel at the back
Child lock, auto imbalance correction, programme memory backup, high and low voltage protection
4 years on the machine, 10 years on the motor, 10 years spare parts support

hotspots.title: Powered by Ai
hotspots.text: Ai detects the weight and type of the fabric, then tailors the wash cycle to suit the load.

hotspots.title: Power Steam
hotspots.text: Steam twice in the wash: at the start to dislodge dirt and kill 99.99% germs, and at the end to reduce wrinkles and keep clothes soft.

hotspots.title: Triadic pulsator
hotspots.text: A 3-step wash action: scrub, swirl and punch.

hotspots.title: Eco Inverter Motor
hotspots.text: Energy-efficient performance with low power consumption, backed by a 10-year motor warranty.
